name: How to Split a PDF
description: Split a PDF into separate pages or extract a specific range — free, no upload.

step.name: Open your PDF
step.text: Click 'Choose files' or drag your PDF into the drop zone.

step.name: Choose split mode
step.text: Select 'Extract pages' to pull out specific pages, or 'Split all' to create one file per page. Enter a page range like 1-3,5 if needed.

step.name: Download the split files
step.text: Click 'Split PDF'. Your extracted pages download as a ZIP file or individual PDFs.
